content.text: •drugs that ↓ absorption of levothyroxine: aluminum, calcium, cholestyramine, iron, magnesium, multivitamins, sevelamer, sucralfate
•drugs that ↓ effectiveness of levothyroxine by ↓ conversion of T4 to T3: beta blockers, amiodarone, systemic steroids, PTU
: DOC if peripheral conversion of T4 is deficient
Clin Use:     -    Stable     -    Predictable potency    -    Long 1/2 life
Dosing: wide range available -sensative to dose chg
Diff prod = poss diff therapeutic index
-     ↑thyroid Sx/S: palpitation, sweat, ↓weight, diarrhea, insomnia, anxiety
non-toxic diffuse goiter or nodular thyroid dz (w suppressed TSH)
Monitoring: when dose chg or brand chg -body is sensitive to chg in this med
TSH: 6-8wks after dose chg, Q3M for 1st yr -> annually when stable
Pt ed: if pt experiences hyperthyroid Sx/S -tell us
Caution: start low -recent MI, CAD, arrhythmias
Class: natural preparation of thyroid glands from pigs -T4/T3
Class: synthetic T4 and synthetic T3
Thyroid — slide extras (not in med-list fields)
TSH = most sensitive indicator of hypothyroid function
TOC for thyroid cancer or respiratory/swallowing difficulty -> results in hypothyroid

: cortisol, as well as other steroid hormones, binds to intracellular receptors – the steroid-receptor complex enters the nucleus and acts as a transcription factor to turn on certain genes, causing synthesis of specific proteins which are responsible for its physiological actions
Increases BG, increases protein catabolism from muscle/bone, antagonist of insulin
Inhibits number/activity of cells involved in inflammatory response
Inhibits histamine release from mast cells
Mineralocorticoid effects: salt/water retention, potassium loss
•Replacement therapy: adrenal insufficiency (Addison's disease) and congenital adrenal hyperplasia (defects in enzymes for steroid hormone synthesis)
: increased appetite/weight gain, fluid retention, emotional instability, insomnia, indigestion, bitter taste, increased BP/BG

: osteoporosis, GI (ulceration, bleeding), psychiatric (mood, psychosis), cataracts, glaucoma, CV (HTN, edema, hypokalemia), diabetes, hyperlipidemia, Cushingoid syndrome, growth failure, impaired wound healing, adrenal suppression, immunosuppression
MOA: anti-inflam via multi actions on several types of leukocytes
↑bone catabolism or antagonize vit D driven Ca absorb
Stim gastric acid & pepsin prod -> take w food

roles.note: titrate to mid-normal TSH; start 25 mcg in heart disease/older patients
T3 not alone long-term; desiccated only if already taking it with a normal TSH

roles.drugs: myxedema coma: IV levothyroxine (T4) 200-400 mcg load (lower end in elderly/cardiac pts)
